name: stream-machine
description: Use hosted Twitch tools through ChatGPT Sites, with a local fallback for desktop streaming tools.

interface.longDescription: Connect Twitch through the Stream Machine ChatGPT Site. Read your channel, preview a title, and approve the exact change in your browser. Local fallback supports OBS, USB Stream Deck, creative workflows, and a separately started event worker. Desktop features require local provider tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Connect Twitch through the Stream Machine Site and preview my first title change. Use localhost only if I choose the desktop fallback.
